about.heading: About
about.bio:
I'm a passionate Fullstack JavaScript/TypeScript developer specializing in building modern, scalable web applications. With expertise in React.js, Next.js, Node.js, and Express.js, I create seamless digital experiences that make a difference.

What sets me apart is my ability to leverage AI tools like ChatGPT and GitHub Copilot to enhance my development workflow, resulting in faster delivery without compromising quality. I'm a quick learner who thrives on solving complex problems and mastering new technologies.

I believe in the power of teamwork — I communicate effectively, adapt easily to any team dynamic, and bring a positive, collaborative energy to every project. Whether it's building from scratch or improving existing systems, I'm always ready for the next challenge.
